title: Russia Biolab Incident 2026 Update — Oct 11, 2026
summary: Backfilled Oct 5-9 events. Russia told the WHO on Oct 6 that no plague case was recorded; the cause of the worker's death remains unestablished. Rospotrebnadzor reported only Covid-19 and rhinovirus among contacts and called a second-infection report fake. Irkutsk lifted precautions as of Oct 9.

title: Russia Biolab Incident 2026 Update — Sat Oct 10, 2026
summary: The World Health Organization confirmed that Russia has reported the death of a laboratory worker at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute.

title: Russia Biolab Incident 2026 Update — Fri Oct 9, 2026
summary: Rospotrebnadzor rejected reports of a second ill person as fake; contact testing found two Covid-19 and two rhinovirus cases and no other pathogens (plague not mentioned).

title: Russia Biolab Incident 2026 Update — Thu Oct 8, 2026
summary: Reports on Oct 8 said the death had not been clearly linked to plague.

title: Russia Biolab Incident 2026 Update — Tue Oct 6, 2026
summary: Russia denied imposing anti-plague measures after the lab worker's death.

title: Russia Biolab Incident 2026 Update — Mon Oct 5, 2026
summary: A Russian report said a 28-year-old worker at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute fell ill and died of pneumonia of unknown cause on Oct 2 in a hospital in Shelekhov.
